name: Pokemon Publisher v2
description: Publishes pending Pokemon TCG promotions to Telegram every 2min within 8h-22h BRT. Quality order: pokemon/copag first, then savings in BRL, then discount %. Max 40/day and 6/hour.

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM promos WHERE posted_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'posted') AS post_count, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM promos WHERE status = 'posted' AND posted_at > now() - interval '1 hour') AS hour_count;

SELECT p.*, c.codigo AS cupom_codigo, c.descricao AS cupom_descricao, c.valor_minimo_cents AS cupom_valor_minimo_cents, to_char(c.valido_ate AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS cupom_valido_ate_br FROM promos p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT cu.* FROM cupons cu WHERE cu.ativo = TRUE AND (cu.valido_de IS NULL OR cu.valido_de <= now()) AND (cu.valido_ate IS NULL OR cu.valido_ate >= now()) AND (cu.valor_minimo_cents IS NULL OR p.price_cents >= cu.valor_minimo_cents) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cupons_itens ci WHERE ci.cupom_id = cu.id AND (ci.item_id = p.item_id OR (ci.catalog_id IS NOT NULL AND ci.catalog_id <> '' AND p.permalink LIKE '%' || ci.catalog_id || '%'))) ORDER BY cu.prioridade DESC, cu.valido_ate ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) c ON TRUE WHERE p.status = 'pending' AND p.utm_link IS NOT NULL AND p.utm_link LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' AND p.utm_link LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%' AND p.thumbnail IS NOT NULL AND p.thumbnail LIKE 'http%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.search_term = 'loja:pokemon' THEN 0 WHEN p.search_term = 'loja:copag' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, (COALESCE(p.original_price_cents, p.price_cents) - p.price_cents) DESC, p.discount_pct DESC LIMIT 1;
=UPDATE promos SET status = 'posted', posted_at = NOW(), telegram_message_id = {{ $json.result.message_id }} WHERE item_id = '{{ $("Format PT-BR Message").item.json.item_id }}';

nodes.name: Registrar Pendentes Impublicaveis

parameters.query: INSERT INTO promos_erros (item_id, error_step, error_msg, payload) SELECT p.item_id, CASE WHEN (p.utm_link IS NULL OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%') THEN 'afiliado' ELSE 'foto' END, CASE WHEN (p.utm_link IS NULL OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%') THEN 'item pendente sem link de afiliado valido: nao sera publicado enquanto o utm_link nao for regravado' ELSE 'item pendente sem foto valida: nao sera publicado enquanto o thumbnail nao for corrigido' END, jsonb_build_object('utm_link', coalesce(p.utm_link, ''), 'permalink', coalesce(p.permalink, ''), 'thumbnail', coalesce(p.thumbnail, '')) FROM promos p WHERE p.status = 'pending' AND (p.utm_link IS NULL OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%' OR p.thumbnail IS NULL OR p.thumbnail NOT LIKE 'http%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promos_erros e WHERE e.item_id = p.item_id AND e.error_step IN ('afiliado', 'foto'));

nodes.notes: Roda em paralelo ao Fetch: denuncia em promos_erros os itens que a consulta da fila ignora por nao terem link de afiliado. Uma linha por item, sem repetir.
